description: This file defines a Java interface named LogNode used for a customizable logging system. The interface specifies a method println for outputting log data, which can be implemented by various classes to handle logging to different targets or formats.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a node in a logging chain that can output log data to a target, possibly passing data to the next node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with a specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.
